items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: It’s what my friend Anat Cohen used to call “Neanderthal interaction.”

ctx.x: Do you consciously avoid sort of copying each other? I mean everybody has great ears in the group, right? So if the piano player played something and you said, “I know what that is I’m going to play it too.” And then it tends to get a little cute or something.
It’s tempting. It’s tempting, yeah. It’s what my friend Anat Cohen used to call “Neanderthal interaction.”
You sounded just like her too.
